pyqgis_plugin.name: Locus Map Control
pyqgis_plugin.description: Integrates Locus Mapsforge offline vector maps, vector tile overlays, and multi-source basemaps into QGIS.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Professional QGIS plugin bringing mobile outdoor offline vector maps (.map), multi-source raster basemaps (Esri, Google Satellite, OpenTopoMap), and vector tile overlay stacks into QGIS 3.x and 4.x. Supports Elevate/Elements themes, automatic language switching (English/Chinese), and built-in developer sponsor support.
